heading: INT. ASTEROID MINING SKIFF "TALLOW-4" - COCKPIT - CONTINUOUS

units.text: INT. ASTEROID MINING SKIFF "TALLOW-4" - COCKPIT - CONTINUOUS
A cramped steel bubble, instrument lights glowing amber.
Beyond the canopy, a tumbling field of black rock, each boulder glinting where the sun hits an ore seam.
A coffee bulb floats beside a headrest, trembling.
A lone figure in a patched flight suit.
TAMARA OKONKWO-HESS (40s, shaved head, calm).
She pilots with one hand, adjusts a thruster dial with the other, and scans the radar, with her boot against the bulkhead for balance and her eyes tracking three rocks at once.
A beep.
A proximity warning.
She taps it away without looking.
Easy, girl.
units.name: TAMARA

units.text: She nudges the stick.
The skiff drifts left, grazing a boulder that spins lazily past.
The radio chirps.
A thin voice, hers, recorded and looped, comes through the speaker.
Tallow Four, Control. Say status. Say status.
units.name: PILOT

units.text: Tamara snorts and silences the loop with a flick of a switch.
Status is lonely.
units.name: TAMARA

units.text: Another beep.
Another rock, the size of a house, looms ahead.
She bites her lip, rolls the skiff, and slips through the gap with a hand's breadth to spare.
Tallow Four, you are out of range. Return to course. Return to course.
units.name: PILOT

units.text: There is no course.
units.name: TAMARA

units.text: She switches the loop off for good.
The cockpit is silent save for the hiss of air.
Out ahead, the field opens, and the sun lights a long vein of silver in a distant rock.
